mutants.description: Treats missing delisting returns as 0.0 instead of assigning Shumway's -30% (NYSE/AMEX) or -55% (NASDAQ) for performance delistings.
Computes sorting breakpoints using all stocks instead of NYSE-only stocks when use_nyse_only is True.
Uses equal weighting instead of market-cap weighting when weighting='value'.
Omits the (1/T) * Sigma_f term in Shanken standard error calculation.
Divides by T instead of T - K - 1 in the unbiased residual covariance matrix calculation for the GRS test.
